texto: Jake and his mom bake a cake.
Jake mixes the cake in a big pan. Mom sets the pan in to bake.
The cake is a fat cake. It has a red flag on top.
Jake will take the cake to Grace. Grace is six. Grace gets a cake and a hug!

preguntas.pregunta: What do Jake and his mom bake?
What is on top of the cake?

texto: Mike has a bike. The bike is white and red.
Mike can ride the bike up the hill. It is a big hill, but Mike can do it.
At the top, Mike stops to rest. He has a wide smile.
Then Mike rides fast to the base of the hill. What a fine ride!

preguntas.pregunta: What does Mike do at the top of the hill?
How does Mike ride down the hill?

texto: Rose has a dog. The dog has a bone.
The dog digs a hole and drops the bone in it. Then the dog runs home.
Rose spots the hole. She lifts the bone up with a stick.
Rose drops the bone next to the dog at home. The dog licks Rose on the nose!

preguntas.pregunta: What does the dog put in the hole?
How does Rose get the bone?
preguntas.respuesta: She lifts it up with a stick.

texto: Duke is a mule. Duke is a cute mule with a big tan nose.
Duke can hum a tune. Hum, hum, hum!
June pets Duke. She hums the tune with him.
Duke and June hum the tune on the hill at sunset.

preguntas.pregunta: When do Duke and June hum on the hill?

texto: Kate and Pete ride to the lake. It is nice and hot.
Pete dives in. Kate sits on a rock and kicks the wet sand.
Then Kate spots a fish. It is huge! It has a stripe on its fin.
At sunset, Kate and Pete go home. They will come back to the lake in June.

preguntas.pregunta: Where do Kate and Pete go?

preguntas.respuesta: A huge fish (with a stripe on its fin).
